environment.defaultGround: Generated grass, rock, soil and paving with world-space macro colour variation, close scanned surface detail and bump relief. Geographic masks constrain the blend; canopy occupancy selects forest floor. Aerial reference remains off by default.
environment.classification: 2 m class-only RGB weights from explicit RGB/height heuristics constrained by OSM geometry; not a trained semantic model.
environment.referenceControl: Aerial reference starts unchecked and shows the photograph for comparison.
environment.evidenceBoundary: LiDAR canopy peaks seed vegetation placement, with evidence-based crown and low-scrub coverage fill. Mapped woodland preserves shaded foliage; the mask includes raised vegetation above 0.7 m. Roots avoid building footprints and mapped roads; crowns can overhang them. Clusters approximate vegetation mass, not surveyed individual trees. 13,399 roofs use sampled colours. Facades, species and crown shapes remain approximate; roof fit is not independently surveyed accuracy.
environment.vegetationRendering: One-kilometre chunks retain fuller crowns and trunks nearby, with cheaper crowns and no trunks at distance. Placement and colour buffers are shared between detail levels. Low scrub follows the terrain slope and its rendered coverage is clipped to measured canopy occupancy; taller crowns can overhang.
environment.vegetationCoverage: Conservative slope-aware projected footprint coverage is checked against the detected vegetation mask; it measures mask coverage, not classification accuracy or surveyed individual tree counts.
environment.landscapeControls: RGBA landscape-controls.png carries canopy occupancy, growing-grass category, DEM sky openness and fixed-sun visibility, with no aerial RGB. Grass condition can misclassify shaded or dry ground. Sky openness affects indirect light; horizon visibility uses the viewer sun direction.
environment.terrainLighting: Published LINZ 1 m DEM hillshade is cached at 2 m. A local ratio removes broad fixed-direction shading before 5 m lighting detail, reducing double lighting with the 3D sun. Missing optional cache produces neutral detail. Finest terrain mesh remains 10 m.

nativePlantModels.installed: One actual textured PlantCatalog Cordyline australis (tī kōuka / cabbage tree) GLB under CC BY 4.0; not a completed flora library.
nativePlantModels.placement: Within 180 m, capped at 48 instances; deterministic 2.5% subset of compatible measured heights from 3.5–9 m. Species assignment is illustrative, not aerial identification.
nativePlantModels.fallback: Distant, unavailable and over-budget vegetation retains generated crown/trunk or scrub proxies. Nearby compatible proxies can use representative broadleaf models.
nativePlantModels.inspection: A full-width Native plants shortcut appears in the existing destinations only after a model loads. Inspection angles are checked against terrain, neighbouring crowns and buildings without hiding scenery.
nativePlantModels.credits: Sources show model author, licence and source links, plus Powered by Poly Haven · CC0 for representative foliage and ground scans. Cabbage tree remains CC BY 4.0. Asset credits: public/plants/ATTRIBUTION.md and public/materials/ATTRIBUTION.md.
nativePlantModels.representative: Three CC0 Poly Haven broadleaf variants: one tree and two shrubs, within 85 m. These are representative foliage rather than verified NZ native species. Models fit evidence-guided height and crown radius; low shrubs align with terrain.
nativePlantModels.budget: 512 total detailed instances and 4 million submitted triangles. Named cabbage trees remain capped at 48 within 180 m. Compatible named-species assignments take precedence over representative variants.

scannedGround.assets: Local CC0 Poly Haven grass and forest-floor 1K colour, OpenGL normal and roughness maps; representative samples, not photographs of actual Lyttelton ground.
scannedGround.scale: Grass repeats at 2.51 m and forest floor at 2.14 m; close detail fades from 65 m to 220 m into retained macro colours.
scannedGround.blend: Geographic class maps constrain the materials; canopy occupancy selects forest floor. Forest-floor albedo is desaturated and toned down in the shader; source maps remain unchanged. Terrain horizon and hillshade lighting are retained.
scannedGround.credits: About this world links Powered by Poly Haven · CC0. Sources and checksums: public/materials/sources.json; attribution: public/materials/ATTRIBUTION.md.

components.html:
About this world

Generated ground materials and scenery. Aerial imagery is available for comparison.

narrative.northStar: A field guide beside the harbour
narrative.overview: An unobtrusive landscape viewer informed by pale paper, vegetation and harbour colours. The generated geographic world leads; compact controls support exploration and inspection. Aerial evidence guides reconstructed scenery and ground classes, while generated materials cover the photograph by default. Georgia gives the place name an editorial character while the operating interface stays quiet and legible.
keyCharacteristics: Full-viewport generated geographic landscape with optional aerial comparison.
Opaque paper panels with restrained depth.
Teal operating controls and clear selected states.

rules.name: The Landscape Rule
rules.body: Keep interface colour restrained so the geographic scene remains the dominant visual field.

rules.name: The Place Name Rule
rules.body: Reserve serif type for the place title and building heading; use sans serif for controls, instructions and evidence.

rules.name: The Clear View Rule
rules.body: Let controls collapse without removing the title, reset action or source attribution.

dos: **Do** keep the landscape visible around compact controls.
**Do** distinguish measured evidence, heuristic classification and procedural approximations in inspection and source text.
**Do** show generated ground by default and use Aerial reference for comparison.
**Do** preserve keyboard focus, reduced motion and responsive control collapse.
**Do** keep source attribution visible in the footer.
donts: **Don't** use decorative imagery in place of geographic evidence.
**Don't** use serif type for routine operating controls.
**Don't** obscure the scene with unnecessary opaque interface surfaces.
